name: terminal
author: lumine-code
backgroundTips: You can open a terminal beside your code with {{ 'terminal:open' | keystroke }}
You can run the selected text in a terminal with {{ 'terminal:run-selected-text' | keystroke }}

terminal.title: Terminal Settings
terminal.description: Settings related to the process running the shell.

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: Command to run to initialize the shell. Leave blank to use the system default.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Arguments to pass to the shell initialization command (comma-separated).

terminalType.title: Terminal Type
terminalType.description: The type of terminal to report; will be assigned to the `TERM` environment variable.

encoding.title: Character Encoding
encoding.description: The encoding to use in a spawned terminal.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Define, override, or delete certain environment variables within the shell.

fallbackEnv.title: Fallback
fallbackEnv.description: Environment variables that should always be present, even if the environment does not define them. Any existing value that may be defined in the environment will take precedence. (Accepts a stringified JSON object.)

overrideEnv.title: Overridden
overrideEnv.description: Environment variables that should always be present _and_ take precedence over values that may already be defined in the environment. Will not supersede any variables that are defined during shell startup. (Accepts a stringified JSON object.)

deleteEnv.title: Deleted
deleteEnv.description: Names of environment variables that should be deleted from a terminal environment whenever present on startup. (Separate multiple entries with commas.)

webLinks.title: Web Links
webLinks.description: Enable [clickable web links](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-web-links). (Note the **Require Modifier to Open URLs** setting below.)

localPathDetection.title: Local Path Detection
localPathDetection.description: Detect local filesystem paths in terminal output and make them clickable. Relative paths are resolved against the shell's current working directory.

ligatures.title: Ligatures
ligatures.description: Enable [ligature support](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-ligatures). Required if you use a coding font that combines sequences like `==` and `>=` into special glyphs. Disabling this option will result in these sequences being rendered as individual characters.

images.title: Inline Images
images.description: Render [inline images](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-image) written to the terminal using SIXEL or iTerm's inline image protocol. Lets tools like `imgcat`, `matplotlib` and `chafa` draw in place instead of opening a window.

imageStorageLimit.title: Inline Image Memory Limit
imageStorageLimit.description: Megabytes of decoded inline images kept per terminal. Older images are dropped first and leave a placeholder behind. (Only applies when **Inline Images** is enabled.)

scrollback.title: Scrollback
scrollback.description: Number of lines kept in the scrollback buffer beyond the visible rows. (Applies to new output immediately; larger values use more memory.)

additionalOptions.title: Additional Options
additionalOptions.description: Options to apply to XTerm terminal objects; [consult the reference](https://xtermjs.org/docs/api/terminal/interfaces/iterminaloptions/#properties). (Accepts a stringified JSON object.)

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: Font to use in terminals. Ignored while **Use Editor Font Family** below is enabled.

useEditorFontFamily.title: Use Editor Font Family
useEditorFontFamily.description: When enabled, terminals will always use the font family specified in the Editor settings instead of the value above.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.description: Font size to use in terminals.

useEditorFontSize.title: Use Editor Font Size
useEditorFontSize.description: When enabled, terminals will always use the font size specified in the Editor settings instead of the value above.

lineHeight.title: Line Height
lineHeight.description: Multiplier to control space between lines.

useEditorLineHeight.title: Use Editor Line Height
useEditorLineHeight.description: When enabled, terminals will always use the line height specified in the Editor settings instead of the value above.

theme.title: Color Theme
theme.description:
Which set of colors to use in the terminal. **Stylesheet** lets you (or a theme) specify terminal colors in a stylesheet; **Config** prefers the values specified in the section below; and the remaining values are legacy preset themes.

If you choose **Config**, expand the **Custom Theme Colors** heading to modify individual colors.

enum.description: Stylesheet (uses colors defined in your UI theme or user stylesheet)

customThemeColors.title: Custom Theme Colors
customThemeColors.description:
Colors to use for a custom terminal theme. These will be ignored unless “Color Theme” above is set to `Config`.

**All of these values support transparency**, even if you can’t specify it via the Settings view! Open your `config.json` to add an alpha channel to any item; specify it using `rgba` syntax (e.g., `rgba(43, 88, 145, 0.5)`).

cursorText.title: Cursor Text
cursorText.description: The color of a character when the cursor is on it _and_ the cursor is in “block” mode.

selectionForeground.title: Selection Foreground
selectionForeground.description: The color of text when it is selected.

matchBorder.title: Match Border (Inactive)
matchBorder.description: The color of the outline around a “find” result when it is inactive.

activeMatchBorder.title: Match Border (Active)
activeMatchBorder.description: The color of the outline around a “find” result when it is active.

matchBackground.title: Match Background (Inactive)
matchBackground.description: The background color of a “find” result when it is inactive.

activeMatchBackground.title: Match Background (Active)
activeMatchBackground.description: The background color of a “find” result when it is active.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: How Lumine manages terminal pane items within the workspace.

defaultContainer.title: Default Container
defaultContainer.description: The destination of a terminal when one is not otherwise specified. (This can happen if you invoke **Terminal: Open** or if one is opened programmatically.)

activeTerminalLogic.title: Active Terminal Logic
activeTerminalLogic.description:
How the “active” terminal is determined.

Many commands operate on the active terminal. If no terminal fits the selected definition, a new terminal will typically be created.

enum.description: Most recently used terminal, whether visible or not

prioritizedCommands.title: Prioritized Commands for Keyboard Handling
prioritizedCommands.description:
A comma-separated list of Lumine commands (or command prefixes) whose keybindings should always be given priority when they overlap with terminal keybindings.

Add a command to this list if you want to guarantee that its keybinding will work properly even if the terminal has focus.

You may specify single commands (like `pane:show-previous-item`); or, to prioritize all the commands in a particular namespace, you may specify just a prefix (like `pane:`).

runInActive.title: Run in Active Terminal
runInActive.description: When enabled, commands invoked via the service API will try to reuse the active terminal (if there is one) instead of opening a new terminal.

leaveOpenAfterExit.title: Leave Open After Exit
leaveOpenAfterExit.description: When enabled, terminal pane items will remain open even after their shells have exited. When disabled, terminal pane items will be removed from the workspace immediately upon shell exit.

showNotifications.title: Show Notifications
showNotifications.description: When enabled, a notification and an in-terminal message are shown when a terminal’s shell exits or restarts. Launch errors are always shown.

relaunchTerminalsOnStartup.title: Relaunch Terminals on Startup
relaunchTerminalsOnStartup.description: When enabled, all terminals that were open at the end of the previous session will be restored when a project is reopened.

copyTextOnSelect.title: Copy Text on Select
copyTextOnSelect.description: When enabled, terminal text will be copied to the clipboard immediately upon selection.

requireModifierToOpenUrls.title: Require Modifier to Open URLs
requireModifierToOpenUrls.description: When enabled, you must hold down `Cmd` or `Ctrl` while clicking on a URL or local path in order to open it.

localPathBehavior.title: Local Path Behavior
localPathBehavior.description: Choose whether detected filesystem paths open in Lumine or externally.

enum.description: Open files in Lumine and directories in the system file manager
Reveal files and open directories in the system file manager

shareProcess.title: Share One Process For All Terminals
shareProcess.description:
Runs every terminal through a single background process instead of giving each one its own.

Each process costs about 100MB and a tenth of a second to start, so sharing makes every terminal after the first open much faster and keeps the memory flat no matter how many you have open. Turn this off to isolate them: a background process that dies then takes down only its own terminal. Applies to terminals opened from now on.

enableDebugLogging.title: Enable Debug Logging
enableDebugLogging.description:
Logs more information from the PTY process to the developer console.

You may want to enable this if you’re reporting a bug and you’re asked to provide more information. Otherwise, leave it disabled; it’s quite verbose!

allowedCommands.title: Allowed Commands
allowedCommands.description: Any sets of commands you’ve allowed to run automatically via a terminal service will appear here when you choose **Always Allow**.

warnAboutModifierWhenOpeningUrls.title: Warn About Modifier When Opening URLs
warnAboutModifierWhenOpeningUrls.description: When enabled _and_ **Require Modifier to Open URLs** is enabled, a user’s initial click on a URL without a modifier key will show a notification explaining why no action was taken. This option is automatically switched to `false` after the first display of this notification.

shellIntegration.title: Shell Integration
shellIntegration.description: Integrate automatically with bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell to track the working directory, mark commands, decorate prompts by exit status and enable prompt-to-prompt navigation.

enabled.title: Enable Shell Integration
enabled.description: Inject shell integration when the configured shell and arguments are supported, while continuing to recognize external OSC 133 and OSC 633 sequences. (Takes effect after a terminal is restarted.)
